from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class SyntaxRollbackError(RuntimeError):
    pass


GIT_PREFIX = [
    "git",
    "-c",
    "core.autocrlf=false",
    "-c",
    "core.safecrlf=false",
]


def _run(
    cmd: list[str],
    *,
    cwd: Path,
    check: bool = True,
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SyntaxRollbackError(
            f"{' '.join(cmd)} fehlgeschlagen: "
            f"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}"
        )
    return proc


def _git(
    repo: Path,
    *args: str,
    check: bool = True,
) -> str:
    return _run(
        [*GIT_PREFIX, *args],
        cwd=repo,
        check=check,
    ).stdout.strip()


def _blob_bytes(
    repo: Path,
    commit: str,
    rel_path: str,
) -> bytes | None:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [*GIT_PREFIX, "show", f"{commit}:{rel_path}"],
        cwd=str(repo),
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return None
    return proc.stdout


def _syntax_ok(
    rel_path: str,
    content: bytes,
) -> bool:
    suffix = Path(rel_path).suffix.lower()
    if suffix not in {".php", ".py", ".sh", ".bash", ".json"}:
        return True

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        test_path = Path(tmp) / Path(rel_path).name
        test_path.write_bytes(content)

        if suffix == ".php":
            cmd = ["php", "-l", str(test_path)]
        elif suffix == ".py":
            cmd = [
                "python3",
                "-m",
                "py_compile",
                str(test_path),
            ]
        elif suffix in {".sh", ".bash"}:
            cmd = ["bash", "-n", str(test_path)]
        else:
            cmd = [
                "python3",
                "-m",
                "json.tool",
                str(test_path),
            ]

        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
        )
        return proc.returncode == 0


def _nearest_valid_ancestor(
    repo: Path,
    rel_path: str,
    base_ref: str,
) -> str:
    history = [
        line.strip()
        for line in _git(
            repo,
            "rev-list",
            "--first-parent",
            "--max-count=25",
            "HEAD^",
            check=False,
        ).splitlines()
        if line.strip()
    ]

    if base_ref not in history:
        history.append(base_ref)

    for commit in history:
        content = _blob_bytes(
            repo,
            commit,
            rel_path,
        )
        if content is None:
            continue
        if _syntax_ok(rel_path, content):
            return commit

    raise SyntaxRollbackError(
        "Kein syntaktisch gültiger Vorgänger für "
        f"{rel_path} gefunden."
    )


def rollback_syntax_failures(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    handoff: dict[str, Any],
    verifier: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    target_paths = {
        str(item)
        for item in handoff.get("target_paths", [])
    }

    syntax_paths = sorted(
        {
            str(item.get("path", "")).strip()
            for item in verifier.get("blockers", [])
            if item.get("code") == "SYNTAX_CHECK_FAILED"
            and str(item.get("path", "")).strip()
            in target_paths
        }
    )

    if not syntax_paths:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "changed": False,
            "restored_paths": [],
            "sources": {},
        }

    branch = _git(
        repo,
        "branch",
        "--show-current",
    )
    if not branch.startswith("ai/job-"):
        raise SyntaxRollbackError(
            "Syntax-Rollback darf nur auf isolierten "
            "ai/job-* Branches arbeiten."
        )

    sources: dict[str, str] = {}
    for rel_path in syntax_paths:
        source = _nearest_valid_ancestor(
            repo,
            rel_path,
            base_ref,
        )
        sources[rel_path] = source

        _git(
            repo,
            "restore",
            "--source",
            source,
            "--staged",
            "--worktree",
            "--",
            rel_path,
        )

    staged = _git(
        repo,
        "diff",
        "--cached",
        "--name-only",
    )
    if not staged:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "changed": False,
            "restored_paths": syntax_paths,
            "sources": sources,
        }

    _run(
        [
            *GIT_PREFIX,
            "-c",
            "user.name=Hermclaw Runtime",
            "-c",
            "user.email=runtime@hermclaw.local",
            "commit",
            "-m",
            (
                "Runtime: rollback syntax-broken target "
                "files to nearest valid ancestor"
            ),
        ],
        cwd=repo,
    )

    _git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"HEAD:{branch}",
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "changed": True,
        "restored_paths": syntax_paths,
        "sources": sources,
        "branch": branch,
        "head": _git(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            "HEAD",
        ),
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Setzt ausschließlich syntax-defekte Ziel-Dateien "
            "auf den nächsten syntaktisch gültigen Vorgänger zurück."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--base-ref", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--handoff", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--verifier", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    repo = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    handoff = json.loads(
        Path(args.handoff).read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    verifier = json.loads(
        Path(args.verifier).read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    result = rollback_syntax_failures(
        repo,
        args.base_ref,
        handoff,
        verifier,
    )

    Path(args.output).write_text(
        json.dumps(
            result,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    if result["changed"]:
        for path in result["restored_paths"]:
            source = result["sources"].get(path, "")
            print(
                "[SYNTAX-ROLLBACK] "
                f"{path} -> {source[:12]}"
            )
    else:
        print(
            "[SYNTAX-ROLLBACK] Kein Rollback nötig."
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
